mutants.description: Parentheses lost around the active-state term, so the live-fault mask applies only to S_RUN and Green stays lit through soft-start whatever fault is live
mutants.reason: If OTP, UVLO or a latch trip goes live while the supervisor is in S_SS, Green_LED stays lit on the next clock instead of going dark. In the fault-free design it is dark.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary leaves out OTP and UVLO, misapplying the window-trip argument that the supervisor leaves S_RUN on its own
mutants.reason: When otp_state or uvlo_state rises while the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN, Green_LED stays lit until the supervisor actually leaves the active state. It should go dark on the next clock.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary leaves out the latch terms, as if Red_LED1 showing the latch made masking Green unnecessary
mutants.reason: When latch_assert or latch_state rises while ss_active or run_active is still high, Green_LED stays lit together with a solid Red_LED1. The design blanks Green on the next clock.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is suppressed while the latch is set, as if the latched-trip display outranked every other red indicator
mutants.reason: When the board is over temperature after a latched trip (or while latch_assert is high), Red_LED2 is dark instead of following otp_state, so the cause of a thermal latch-up is hidden on the panel.
